mapper.select:
SELECT e.id,e.department as department_id,d.name as department_name,e.occurringtime, e.expectedterminaltime,e.terminaltime,e.incidenttype,e.road as road_id,r.name as road_name, e.direction,e.weather,e.numberofoccupiedlanes,e.vehiclesinfo,e.numberoflanes,e.numberofpeople, e.numberofslightinjury,e.numberofseriousinjury,e.numberoffatality,e.lng,e.lat FROM ods_tims_realtime_event e LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_road r on r.id = e.road LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_department d on d.id = e.department
ORDER BY e.occurringtime DESC
mapper.sql:
e.scences = '交通事故' and e.occurringtime >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') and e.occurringtime <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') and d.name like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%') and r.name like concat('%', #{location}, '%') and e.incidenttype like concat('%', #{keyWord}, '%') and e.vehiclesinfo like concat('%', #{caseKeyWord}, '%') and e.f_hour >= #{startHour} and e.f_hour <= #{endHour}
and
( numberofslightinjury IS NOT NULL AND numberofslightinjury > 0 and (numberofseriousinjury IS NULL OR numberofseriousinjury = 0) and (numberoffatality IS NULL OR numberoffatality = 0) )
( numberofseriousinjury IS NOT NULL AND numberofseriousinjury > 0 and (numberoffatality IS NULL OR numberoffatality = 0) )
(numberoffatality IS NOT NULL AND numberoffatality > 0)
( (numberoffatality IS NULL OR numberofseriousinjury = 0) and (numberofslightinjury IS NULL OR numberofslightinjury = 0) and (numberofseriousinjury IS NULL OR numberofseriousinjury = 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT( e.id ) AS total_num, COUNT(IF(( numberofslightinjury IS NOT NULL AND numberofslightinjury > 0 and (numberofseriousinjury IS NULL OR numberofseriousinjury = 0) and (numberoffatality IS NULL OR numberoffatality = 0) ), 1, NULL ) ) AS slight_injury_num, COUNT(IF(( numberofseriousinjury IS NOT NULL AND numberofseriousinjury > 0 and (numberoffatality IS NULL OR numberoffatality = 0) ), 1, NULL ) ) AS serious_injury_num, COUNT(IF(numberoffatality IS NOT NULL AND numberoffatality > 0, 1, NULL )) AS death_num, COUNT(IF( (numberoffatality IS NULL OR numberoffatality = 0) and (numberofslightinjury IS NULL OR numberofslightinjury = 0) and (numberofseriousinjury IS NULL OR numberofseriousinjury = 0), 1, NULL ) ) as simple_num FROM ods_tims_realtime_event e LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_road r on r.id = e.road LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_department d on d.id = e.department

SELECT t.road as road_id,r1.name as road_name,r1.departmentid as dept_id,d.name as dept_name,t.total_num FROM ( SELECT e.road,COUNT(e.id) AS total_num FROM ods_tims_realtime_event e LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_road r on r.id = e.road LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_department d on d.id = e.department
GROUP BY e.road ) t LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_road r1 ON r1.id = t.road LEFT JOIN ods_tims_dt_department d ON d.id = r1.departmentid ORDER BY t.total_num desc LIMIT #{limitSize}
